name: Zhichi Yao Xin - Proof of existence
source:
Even if there is the same goal, everyone will have their own way of achieving it. Two people with opposite ideas will never understand each other even if they are in the same room.
The only one who can bridge this gap is...

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2797180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
即使有相同的目标，每个人也会有自己的实现方式。两个想法相反的人，即使共处一室，也永远不会互相理解。
唯一能够弥补这一差距的人是……

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2797180/]Steam[/url]]
